units.zh: 蕭明 蕭祗 蕭退 蕭放 徐之才
units.en: Xiao Ming; Xiao Zhi; Xiao Tui; Xiao Fang; Xu Zhicai
units.literal: Xiao Ming; Xiao Zhi; Xiao Tui; Xiao Fang; Xu Zhicai

units.zh: 蕭明，蘭陵人，梁武帝長兄長沙王懿之子。
units.en: Xiao Ming was from Lanling, son of Prince of Changsha Yi, eldest brother of Emperor Wu of Liang.
units.literal: Xiao Ming was a man of Lanling, son of Prince of Changsha Yi, the Liang emperor Wu's eldest brother's son.

units.zh: 在其本朝，甚為梁武所親愛。
units.en: In his own court he was greatly beloved by Emperor Wu of Liang.
units.literal: In his own dynasty he was greatly beloved by Liang Wu.

units.zh: 少歷顯職，封湞陽侯。
units.en: In youth he held eminent posts and was enfeoffed Marquis of Zhenyang.
units.literal: In youth he passed through eminent offices and was enfeoffed Marquis of Zhenyang.

units.zh: 太清中，以為豫州刺史。
units.en: During the Taiqing era he was made inspector of Yuzhou.
units.literal: In the Taiqing era he was made inspector of Yuzhou.

units.zh: 梁主旣納侯景，詔明率水陸諸軍趨彭城，大圖進取。
units.en: After the Liang ruler accepted Hou Jing, an edict ordered Ming to lead land and river forces toward Pengcheng for a major advance.
units.literal: After the Liang ruler had accepted Hou Jing, an edict ordered Ming to lead land and river forces toward Pengcheng, with a grand design of advance.

units.zh: 又命兗州刺史南康嗣王會理總馭群帥，指授方略。
units.en: He also ordered Yanzhou inspector Heir Prince of Nankang Hui Li to take overall command of the generals and set strategy.
units.literal: He also ordered Yanzhou inspector Heir Prince of Nankang Hui Li to command all commanders and assign strategy.

units.zh: 明渡淮未幾，官軍破之，盡俘其衆。
units.en: Ming had crossed the Huai only a short while when the government army defeated him and took his entire force captive.
units.literal: Ming had crossed the Huai only a short while when the government army defeated him and took all his host captive.

units.zh: 魏帝升門樓，親引見明及諸將帥，釋其禁，送於晉陽。
units.en: The Wei emperor ascended the gate tower, received Ming and the generals in person, released their bonds, and sent them to Jinyang.
units.literal: The Wei emperor ascended the gate tower and personally received Ming and the generals, released their bonds, and sent them to Jinyang.

units.zh: 世宗禮明甚重，謂之曰：「先王與梁主和好十有餘年，聞彼禮佛文，常雲奉為魏主，並及先王，此甚是梁主厚意。
units.en: Gao Cheng treated Ming with great courtesy and said to him, "The late king and the Liang ruler were on good terms for more than ten years; I heard that when he performed Buddhist rites he would say he did them for the Wei ruler and for the late king as well—this was truly the Liang ruler's great kindness.
units.literal: Gao Cheng treated Ming with great courtesy and said to him: "The late king and the Liang ruler were on good terms for more than ten years; I heard that when he performed Buddhist rites he would say he did them for the Wei ruler and for the late king as well—this was truly the Liang ruler's great kindness.

units.zh: 不謂一朝失信，致此紛擾。
units.en: Who would have thought that in a single morning faith would be broken and bring this turmoil.
units.literal: Who would have thought that in a single morning faith would be broken and bring this turmoil.

units.zh: 自出師薄伐，無戰不克，無城不陷，今自欲和，非是力屈。
units.en: Since our armies went forth on a light campaign, there has been no battle we did not win, no city we did not take; now that we ourselves wish peace, it is not because our strength is spent.
units.literal: Since our armies went forth on a light campaign, there has been no battle we did not win, no city we did not take; now that we ourselves wish peace, it is not because our strength is spent.

units.zh: 境上之事，知非梁主本心，當是侯景違命扇動耳。
units.en: Matters on the border—I know they are not the Liang ruler's true intent; surely Hou Jing defied orders and stirred this up.
units.literal: Matters on the border—I know they are not the Liang ruler's true intent; surely Hou Jing defied orders and stirred this up.

units.zh: 侯可遣使諮論，若猶存先王分義，重成通和者，吾不必違先王之旨，侯及諸人並卽放還。」
units.en: You may send envoys to consult; if he still honors the late king's bond and restores friendly relations, I need not go against the late king's wish—you and the others will all be released at once."
units.literal: You may send envoys to consult; if he still honors the late king's bond and restores friendly relations, I need not go against the late king's wish—you and the others will all be released at once."

units.zh: 於是使人以明書告梁主，梁主乃致書以慰世宗。
units.en: Thereupon he had men report to the Liang ruler with Ming's letter; the Liang ruler then sent a letter in reply to comfort Gao Cheng.
units.literal: Thereupon he had men report to the Liang ruler with Ming's letter; the Liang ruler then sent a letter in reply to comfort Gao Cheng.

units.zh: 天保六年，梁元為西魏所滅，顯祖詔立明為梁主，前所獲梁將湛海珍等皆聽從明歸，令上黨王渙率衆以送。
units.en: In the sixth year of Tianbao, when Emperor Yuan of Liang was destroyed by Western Wei, Gao Yang issued an edict installing Ming as Liang ruler; Liang generals previously captured, such as Zhan Haizhen, were all allowed to follow Ming home, and Prince of Shangdang Huan was ordered to lead troops to escort them.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tianbao, when Emperor Yuan of Liang was destroyed by Western Wei, Gao Yang issued an edict installing Ming as Liang ruler; Liang generals previously captured, such as Zhan Haizhen, were all allowed to follow Ming home, and Prince of Shangdang Huan was ordered to lead troops to escort them.

units.zh: 是時梁太尉王僧辯、司空陳霸先在建鄴，推晉安王方智為丞相。
units.en: At that time Liang grand commandant Wang Sengbian and minister of works Chen Baxian were at Jiankang; they installed Prince of Jin'an Fang Zhi as chancellor.
units.literal: At that time Liang Grand Commandant Wang Sengbian and Minister of Works Chen Baxian were at Jiankang; they installed Prince of Jin'an Fang Zhi as chancellor.

units.zh: 顯祖賜僧辯、霸先璽書，僧辯未奉詔。
units.en: Gao Yang bestowed sealed letters on Sengbian and Baxian; Sengbian did not obey the edict.
units.literal: Gao Yang bestowed sealed letters on Sengbian and Baxian; Sengbian did not obey the edict.

units.zh: 上黨王進軍，明又與僧辯書，往復再三，陳禍福，僧辯初不納。
units.en: Prince of Shangdang advanced his army; Ming also exchanged letters with Sengbian back and forth several times, setting out fortune and calamity, but at first Sengbian would not accept him.
units.literal: Prince of Shangdang advanced his army; Ming also exchanged letters with Sengbian back and forth several times, setting out fortune and calamity, but at first Sengbian would not accept him.

units.zh: 旣而上黨王破東關，斬裴之橫，江表危懼，僧辯乃啟上黨求納明，遣舟艦迎接。
units.en: Then Prince of Shangdang broke Dongguan and beheaded Pei Zhiheng; the lands south of the Yangtze were gripped with fear, and Sengbian then memorialized Prince of Shangdang asking to admit Ming and sent warships to receive him.
units.literal: Then Prince of Shangdang broke Dongguan and beheaded Pei Zhiheng; the lands south of the Yangtze were gripped with fear, and Sengbian then memorialized Prince of Shangdang asking to admit Ming and sent warships to receive him.

units.zh: 王饗梁朝將士，及與明刑牲歃血，載書而盟。
units.en: The prince feasted Liang officers and men and, with Ming, slaughtered a victim and drank the blood, loading the covenant onto a chariot.
units.literal: The prince feasted Liang officers and men and, with Ming, slaughtered a victim and drank the blood, loading the covenant onto a chariot.

units.zh: 於是梁輿東度，齊師北反。
units.en: Thereupon the Liang carriage went east across the river and the Qi army turned north.
units.literal: Thereupon the Liang carriage went east across the river and the Qi army turned north.

units.zh: 侍中裴英起衛送明入建鄴，遂稱尊號，改承聖四年為天成元年，大赦天下，宇文黑獺、賊詧等不在赦例。
units.en: Palace attendant Pei Yingqi guarded and escorted Ming into Jiankang; he then assumed the imperial title, changed the fourth year of Chengsheng to the first year of Tiancheng, and proclaimed a general amnesty—Yuwen Heitu, the rebel Cha, and the like were not within the amnesty.
units.literal: Palace attendant Pei Yingqi guarded and escorted Ming into Jiankang; he then assumed the imperial title, changed the fourth year of Chengsheng to the first year of Tiancheng, and proclaimed a general amnesty—Yuwen Heitu, the rebel Chao, and the like were not within the amnesty.

units.zh: 以方智為太子，授王僧辯大司馬。
units.en: Fang Zhi was made heir apparent; Wang Sengbian was appointed grand marshal.
units.literal: Fang Zhi was made heir apparent; Wang Sengbian was appointed grand marshal.

units.zh: 明上表遣第二息章馳到京都，拜謝宮闕。
units.en: Ming submitted a memorial sending his second son Zhang hurrying to the capital to bow in thanks before the palace.
units.literal: Ming submitted a memorial sending his second son Zhang hurrying to the capital to bow in thanks before the palace.

units.zh: 冬，霸先襲殺僧辯，復立方智，以明為太傅、建安王。
units.en: In winter Baxian attacked and killed Sengbian, restored Fang Zhi, and made Ming grand tutor and Prince of Jian'an.
units.literal: In winter Baxian attacked and killed Sengbian, restored Fang Zhi, and made Ming grand tutor and Prince of Jian'an.

units.zh: 霸先奉表朝廷，云僧辯陰謀篡逆，故誅之。
units.en: Baxian submitted a memorial to the court saying Sengbian had plotted treason in secret and was therefore executed.
units.literal: Baxian submitted a memorial to the court saying Sengbian had plotted treason in secret and was therefore executed.

units.zh: 方智請稱臣，永為藩國，齊遣行臺司馬恭及梁人盟於歷陽。
units.en: Fang Zhi asked to style himself subject and remain a vassal state forever; Qi sent acting commissioner Sima Gong and Liang men to covenant at Liyang.
units.literal: Fang Zhi asked to style himself subject and remain a vassal state forever; Qi sent acting commissioner Sima Gong and Liang men to covenant at Liyang.

units.zh: 明年，詔徵明。
units.en: The next year an edict summoned Ming.
units.literal: The next year an edict summoned Ming.

units.zh: 霸先猶稱藩，將遣使送明，會明疽發背死。
units.en: Baxian still styled himself vassal and was about to send envoys to deliver Ming, but Ming died of a carbuncle on his back.
units.literal: Baxian still styled himself vassal and was about to send envoys to deliver Ming, but Ming died of a carbuncle on his back.

units.zh: 梁將王琳在江上與霸先相抗，顯祖遣兵納梁永嘉王蕭莊主梁祀。
units.en: Liang general Wang Lin on the river resisted Baxian; Gao Yang sent troops to install Liang Prince of Yongjia Xiao Zhuang to uphold the Liang succession.
units.literal: Liang general Wang Lin on the river resisted Baxian; Gao Yang sent troops to install Liang Prince of Yongjia Xiao Zhuang to uphold the Liang succession.

units.zh: 九年二月，自湓城濟江，三月，卽帝位於郢州，年號天啟，王琳總其軍國，追諡明曰閔皇帝。
units.en: In the second month of the ninth year he crossed the river from Pencheng; in the third month he took the throne at Yingzhou, era name Tianqi; Wang Lin directed state and army; posthumous title for Ming was Emperor Min.
units.literal: In the second month of the ninth year he crossed the river from Pencheng; in the third month he took the throne at Yingzhou, era name Tianqi; Wang Lin directed state and army; posthumous title for Ming was Emperor Min.

units.zh: 明年，莊為陳人所敗，遂入朝，封為侯。
units.en: The next year Zhuang was defeated by Chen men and then entered court; he was enfeoffed marquis.
units.literal: The next year Zhuang was defeated by Chen men and then entered court; he was enfeoffed marquis.

units.zh: 朝廷許以興復，竟不果。
units.en: The court had promised restoration, but in the end it did not come to pass.
units.literal: The court had promised restoration, but in the end it did not come to pass.

units.zh: 後主亡之日，莊在鄴飲氣而死。
units.en: On the day the Last Lord perished, Zhuang died in Ye from pent-up grief.
units.literal: On the day the Last Lord perished, Zhuang died in Ye from pent-up grief.

units.zh: 蕭祗，字敬式，梁武弟南平王偉之子也。
units.en: Xiao Zhi, style Jingshi, was son of Emperor Wu of Liang's younger brother Prince of Nanping Wei.
units.literal: Xiao Zhi, style Jingshi, was son of Liang Wu's younger brother Prince of Nanping Wei.

units.zh: 少聰敏，美容儀。
units.en: In youth he was clever and keen, with fine looks.
units.literal: In youth he was clever and keen, with fine looks.

units.zh: 在梁封定襄侯，位東揚州刺史。
units.en: In Liang he was enfeoffed Marquis of Dingxiang and held the post of eastern Yangzhou inspector.
units.literal: In Liang he was enfeoffed Marquis of Dingxiang and held the post of eastern Yangzhou inspector.

units.zh: 於時江左承平，政寬人慢，祗獨莅以嚴切，梁武悅之。
units.en: At that time the lands east of the Yangtze were at peace; government was lax and people grew slack—Zhi alone governed with severity, and Emperor Wu of Liang was pleased.
units.literal: At that time the lands east of the Yangtze were at peace; government was lax and people grew slack—Zhi alone governed with severity, and Liang Wu was pleased.

units.zh: 遷北兗州刺史。
units.en: He was transferred to northern Yanzhou inspector.
units.literal: He was transferred to northern Yanzhou inspector.

units.zh: 太清二年，侯景圍建鄴。
units.en: In the second year of Taiqing, Hou Jing besieged Jiankang.
units.literal: In the second year of Taiqing, Hou Jing besieged Jiankang.

units.zh: 祗聞臺城失守，遂來奔。
units.en: Zhi heard the capital had fallen and came to surrender.
units.literal: Zhi heard the capital had fallen and came to surrender.

units.zh: 以武定七年至鄴，文襄令魏收、邢卲與相接對。
units.en: In the seventh year of Wuding he reached Ye; Gao Cheng had Wei Shou and Xing Shao meet and converse with him.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Wuding he reached Ye; Gao Cheng had Wei Shou and Xing Shao meet and converse with him.

units.zh: 歷位太子少傅，領平陽王師，封清河郡公。
units.en: He passed through the posts of heir apparent junior tutor and tutor to Prince of Pingyang, and was enfeoffed Duke of Qinghe commandery.
units.literal: He passed through the posts of heir apparent junior tutor and tutor to Prince of Pingyang, and was enfeoffed Duke of Qinghe commandery.

units.zh: 齊天保初，授右光祿大夫，領國子祭酒。
units.en: At the beginning of Qi Tianbao he was made right bright light grand master and director of the imperial university.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qi Tianbao he was made Right Bright Light Grand Master and director of the Imperial University.

units.zh: 時梁元帝平侯景，復與齊通好，文宣欲放祗等還南。
units.en: When Emperor Yuan of Liang had pacified Hou Jing and renewed friendly relations with Qi, Gao Yang wished to release Zhi and the others to return south.
units.literal: When Emperor Yuan of Liang had pacified Hou Jing and renewed friendly relations with Qi, Gao Yang wished to release Zhi and the others to return south.

units.zh: 俄而西魏剋江陵，遂留鄴都，卒。
units.en: Before long Western Wei took Jiangling; he therefore remained at Ye and died.
units.literal: Before long Western Wei took Jiangling; he therefore remained at Ye and died.

units.zh: 贈中書監、車騎大將軍、揚州刺史。
units.en: Posthumous gifts: secretariat director, chariot and cavalry grand general, Yangzhou inspector.
units.literal: Posthumous gifts: secretariat director, chariot and cavalry grand general, Yangzhou inspector.

units.zh: 蕭退，梁武帝弟司空鄱陽王恢之子也。
units.en: Xiao Tui was son of Emperor Wu of Liang's younger brother minister of works Prince of Poyang Hui.
units.literal: Xiao Tui was son of Liang emperor Wu's younger brother Minister of Works Prince of Poyang Hui.

units.zh: 退在梁封湘潭侯，位青州刺史。
units.en: In Liang Tui was enfeoffed Marquis of Xiangtan and held Qingzhou inspector.
units.literal: In Liang Tui was enfeoffed Marquis of Xiangtan and held Qingzhou inspector.

units.zh: 建鄴陷，與從兄祗俱入東魏。
units.en: When Jiankang fell, he entered Eastern Wei together with his elder cousin Zhi.
units.literal: When Jiankang fell, he entered Eastern Wei together with his elder cousin Zhi.

units.zh: 齊天保中，位金紫光祿大夫，卒。
units.en: In Qi Tianbao he held the post of golden purple light grand master and died.
units.literal: In Qi Tianbao he held the post of golden purple light grand master and died.

units.zh: 子慨，深沉有禮，樂善好學，攻草隸書。
units.en: His son Kai was deep and reserved, courteous, fond of goodness and eager to learn, and skilled at cursive and clerical script.
units.literal: His son Kai was deep and reserved, courteous, fond of goodness and eager to learn, and skilled at cursive and clerical script.

units.zh: 南士中稱為長者。
units.en: Among southern gentlemen he was called an elder.
units.literal: Among southern gentlemen he was called an elder.

units.zh: 歷著作佐郎，待詔文林館，卒於司徒從事中郎。
units.en: He passed through associate editor of the historiography office and attendant at Wenslin Hall, and died as aide to the director of the masters of writing.
units.literal: He passed through associate editor of the Historiography Office and attendant at Wenslin Hall, and died as aide to the director of the masters of writing.

units.zh: 蕭放，字希逸，隨父祗至鄴。
units.en: Xiao Fang, style Xiyi, followed his father Zhi to Ye.
units.literal: Xiao Fang, style Xiyi, followed his father Zhi to Ye.

units.zh: 祗卒，放居喪以孝聞。
units.en: When Zhi died, Fang's mourning for him won fame for filial piety.
units.literal: When Zhi died, Fang's mourning for him won fame for filial piety.

units.zh: 所居廬室前有二慈鳥來集，各據一樹為巢，自午以前，馴庭飲啄，午後更不下樹，每臨時，舒翅悲鳴，全似哀泣。
units.en: Before the mourning hut two loving birds came and gathered; each took a tree for its nest; from before noon they were tame in the courtyard, drinking and pecking; after noon they no longer left the trees; whenever the hour came they spread their wings and cried mournfully, altogether like weeping in grief.
units.literal: Before the mourning hut two loving birds came and gathered; each took a tree for its nest; from before noon they were tame in the courtyard, drinking and pecking; after noon they no longer left the trees; whenever the hour came they spread their wings and cried mournfully, altogether like weeping in grief.

units.zh: 家人伺之，未常有闕。
units.en: The household watched them and never found an absence.
units.literal: The household watched them and never found an absence.

units.zh: 時以為至孝之感。
units.en: People of the time took it as the response of utmost filial piety.
units.literal: People of the time took it as the response of utmost filial piety.

units.zh: 服闋，襲爵。
units.en: When mourning ended he inherited the title.
units.literal: When mourning ended he inherited the title.

units.zh: 武平中，待詔文林館。
units.en: In the Wuping era he was attendant at Wenslin Hall.
units.literal: In the Wuping era he was attendant at Wenslin Hall.

units.zh: 放性好文詠，頗善丹青，因此在宮中披覽書史及近世詩賦，監畫工作屏風等雜物見知，遂被眷待。
units.en: Fang by nature loved literary composition and was fairly skilled at painting; therefore in the palace he perused histories and recent poetry and rhapsodies, oversaw painters at work on screens and other miscellaneous objects, became known, and was favored.
units.literal: Fang by nature loved literary composition and was fairly skilled at painting; therefore in the palace he perused histories and recent poetry and rhapsodies, oversaw painters at work on screens and other miscellaneous objects, became known, and was favored.

units.zh: 累遷太子中庶子、散騎常侍。
units.en: He was promoted repeatedly to heir apparent attendant and attendant-in-ordinary.
units.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to heir apparent attendant and attendant-in-ordinary.

units.zh: 徐之才，丹陽人也。
units.en: Xu Zhicai was a man of Danyang.
units.literal: Xu Zhicai was a man of Danyang.

units.zh: 父雄，事南齊，位蘭陵太守，以醫術為江左所稱。
units.en: His father Xiong served Southern Qi as administrator of Lanling and was famed in the lands east of the Yangtze for medical skill.
units.literal: His father Xiong served Southern Qi as administrator of Lanling and was famed in the lands east of the Yangtze for medical skill.

units.zh: 之才幼而儁發，五歲誦《孝經》，八歲略通義旨。
units.en: Zhicai in childhood was precocious; at five he recited the Classic of Filial Piety, and at eight he had a rough grasp of its meaning.
units.literal: Zhicai in childhood was precocious; at five he recited the Classic of Filial Piety, and at eight he had a rough grasp of its meaning.

units.zh: 曾與從兄康造梁太子詹事汝南周舍宅聽《老子》。
units.en: Once he went with his elder cousin Kang to the house of Liang heir apparent's household chief Runan Zhou She to hear the Laozi.
units.literal: Once he went with his elder cousin Kang to the house of Liang heir apparent's household chief Runan Zhou She to hear the Laozi.

units.zh: 捨為設食，乃戲之曰：「徐郎不用心思義，而但事食乎？」
units.en: She set out food and then teased him, saying, "Master Xu, you do not apply your mind to meaning but only to eating?"
units.literal: She set out food and then teased him, saying: "Master Xu, you do not apply your mind to meaning but only to eating?"

units.zh: 之才答曰：「蓋聞聖人虛其心而實其腹。」
units.en: Zhicai answered, "I have heard that the sage empties his mind and fills his belly."
units.literal: Zhicai answered: "I have heard that the sage empties his mind and fills his belly."

units.zh: 捨嗟賞之。
units.en: She sighed in admiration.
units.literal: She sighed in admiration.

units.zh: 年十三，召為太學生，粗通《禮》、《易》。
units.en: At thirteen he was summoned as imperial academy student and had a rough mastery of the Rites and the Changes.
units.literal: At thirteen he was summoned as Imperial Academy student and had a rough mastery of the Rites and the Changes.

units.zh: 彭城劉孝綽、河東裴子野、吳郡張嵊等每共論《周易》及《喪服》儀，酬應如響。
units.en: Pengcheng Liu Xiaochuo, Hedong Pei Ziye, Wu commandery Zhang Sheng, and others often debated the Book of Changes and mourning-garment ritual with him; his replies came like an echo.
units.literal: Pengcheng Liu Xiaochuo, Hedong Pei Ziye, Wu commandery Zhang Sheng, and others often debated the Book of Changes and mourning-garment ritual with him; his replies came like an echo.

units.zh: 咸共歎曰：「此神童也。」
units.en: They all sighed together, "This is a divine child."
units.literal: They all sighed together: "This is a divine child."

units.zh: 孝綽又云：「徐郎燕頷，有班定遠之相。」
units.en: Xiaochuo also said, "Master Xu has a swallow jaw—he has the look of Ban Chao the Distance-Pacifier."
units.literal: Xiaochuo also said: "Master Xu has a swallow jaw—he has the look of Ban Chao the Distance-Pacifier."

units.zh: 陳郡袁昂領丹陽尹，辟為主簿，人務事宜，皆被顧訪。
units.en: Chen commandery Yuan Ang held Danyang prefect; he recruited Zhicai as chief clerk, and whenever men had business affairs they were all referred to him for counsel.
units.literal: Chen commandery Yuan Ang held Danyang prefect; he recruited Zhicai as chief clerk, and whenever men had business affairs they were all referred to him for counsel.

units.zh: 郡廨遭火，之才起望，夜中不著衣，披紅服帕出房，映光為昂所見。
units.en: The prefectural offices suffered fire; Zhicai rose to look and in the night wore no clothes, but came out of the room in a red kerchief over his shoulders; the light caught him and Ang saw it.
units.literal: The prefectural offices suffered fire; Zhicai rose to look and in the night wore no clothes, but came out of the room in a red kerchief over his shoulders; the light caught him and Ang saw it.

units.zh: 功曹白請免職，昂重其才術，仍特原之。
units.en: The merit officer memorialized asking that he be dismissed; Ang valued his talent and skill and specially pardoned him.
units.literal: The merit officer memorialized asking that he be dismissed; Ang valued his talent and skill and specially pardoned him.

units.zh: 豫章王綜出鎮江都，復除豫章王國左常侍，又轉綜鎮北主簿。
units.en: Prince of Yuzhang Zong went out to garrison Jiangdu; Zhicai was again made left regular attendant of the Yuzhang kingdom, then transferred to Zong's northern campaign chief clerk.
units.literal: Prince of Yuzhang Zong went out to garrison Jiangdu; Zhicai was again made left regular attendant of the Yuzhang kingdom, then transferred to Zong's northern campaign chief clerk.

units.zh: 及綜入魏，三軍散走，之才退至呂梁，橋斷路絕，遂為魏統軍石茂孫所止。
units.en: When Zong entered Wei the three armies scattered and fled; Zhicai retreated to Lüliang; the bridge was cut and the road gone, and he was stopped by Wei commanding general Shi Maosun.
units.literal: When Zong entered Wei the three armies scattered and fled; Zhicai retreated to Lüliang; the bridge was cut and the road gone, and he was stopped by Wei commanding general Shi Maosun.

units.zh: 綜入魏旬月，位至司空。
units.en: Within a month of Zong's entering Wei he reached the rank of minister of works.
units.literal: Within a month of Zong's entering Wei he reached the rank of minister of works.

units.zh: 魏聽綜收斂僚屬，乃訪之才在彭泗，啟魏帝云：「之才大善醫術，兼有機辯。」
units.en: Wei allowed Zong to gather his staff; he then inquired after Zhicai at Peng and Si and reported to the Wei emperor, "Zhicai is greatly skilled in medicine and also has ready wit."
units.literal: Wei allowed Zong to gather his staff; he then inquired after Zhicai at Peng and Si and reported to the Wei emperor: "Zhicai is greatly skilled in medicine and also has ready wit."

units.zh: 詔徵之才。
units.en: An edict summoned Zhicai.
units.literal: An edict summoned Zhicai.

units.zh: 孝昌二年，至洛，勑居南館，禮遇甚優。
units.en: In the second year of Xiaochang he reached Luoyang; he was ordered to lodge in the Southern Lodge and received very generous treatment.
units.literal: In the second year of Xiaochang he reached Luoyang; he was ordered to lodge in the Southern Lodge and received very generous treatment.

units.zh: 從祖謇子踐啟求之才還宅。
units.en: Cousin Zhan's son Jian memorialized asking that Zhicai return home.
units.literal: Cousin Zhan's son Jian memorialized asking that Zhicai return home.

units.zh: 之才藥石多效，又闚涉經史，發言辯捷，朝賢競相要引，為之延譽。
units.en: Zhicai's medicines were often effective; he also dipped into the classics and histories; when he spoke he was sharp and quick; court worthies vied to invite him and spread his fame.
units.literal: Zhicai's medicines were often effective; he also dipped into the classics and histories; when he spoke he was sharp and quick; court worthies vied to invite him and spread his fame.

units.zh: 武帝時，封昌安縣侯。
units.en: In the time of Emperor Wu he was enfeoffed Marquis of Chang'an county.
units.literal: In the time of Emperor Wu he was enfeoffed Marquis of Chang'an county.

units.zh: 天平中，齊神武徵赴晉陽，常在內館，禮遇稍厚。
units.en: In the Tianping era Gao Huan summoned him to Jinyang; he was constantly in the inner lodge and his treatment grew somewhat richer.
units.literal: In the Tianping era Gao Huan summoned him to Jinyang; he was constantly in the inner lodge and his treatment grew somewhat richer.

units.zh: 武定四年，自散騎常侍轉秘書監。
units.en: In the fourth year of Wuding he was transferred from attendant-in-ordinary to secretariat director.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Wuding he was transferred from attendant-in-ordinary to secretariat director.

units.zh: 文宣作相，普加黜陟。
units.en: When Gao Yang became chancellor he promoted and demoted widely.
units.literal: When Gao Yang became chancellor he promoted and demoted widely.

units.zh: 楊愔以其南土之人，不堪典秘書，轉授金紫光祿大夫，以魏收代領之。
units.en: Yang Yin, because he was a man of the southern lands and unfit to direct the secretariat, transferred him to golden purple light grand master and had Wei Shou replace him in that office.
units.literal: Yang Yin, because he was a man of the southern lands and unfit to direct the secretariat, transferred him to golden purple light grand master and had Wei Shou replace him in that office.

units.zh: 之才甚怏怏不平。
units.en: Zhicai was very resentful and displeased.
units.literal: Zhicai was very resentful and displeased.

units.zh: 之才少解天文，兼圖讖之學，共館客宋景業參校吉兇，知午年必有革易，因高德政啟之。
units.en: Zhicai from youth understood astronomy and also the learning of prognostic texts; with lodge companion Song Jingye he compared auspice and ill omen and knew that in the wu year there would surely be change; he therefore reported this through Gao Dezheng.
units.literal: Zhicai from youth understood astronomy and also the learning of prognostic texts; with lodge companion Song Jingye he compared auspice and ill omen and knew that in the wu year there would surely be change; he therefore reported this through Gao Dezheng.

units.zh: 文宣聞而大悅。
units.en: Gao Yang heard it and was greatly pleased.
units.literal: Gao Yang heard it and was greatly pleased.

units.zh: 時自婁太后及勳貴臣咸云關西旣是勁敵，恐其有挾天子令諸侯之辭，不可先行禪代事。
units.en: At the time from Empress Dowager Lou down to meritorious ministers all said Guanxi was already a formidable foe and feared they would use the phrase of taking the Son of Heaven in hand to command the feudal lords—one must not first carry out the abdication.
units.literal: At the time from Empress Dowager Lou down to meritorious ministers all said Guanxi was already a formidable foe and feared they would use the phrase of taking the Son of Heaven in hand to command the feudal lords—one must not first carry out the abdication.

units.zh: 之才獨云：「千人逐免，一人得之，諸人咸息。
units.en: Zhicai alone said, "A thousand men chase a hare; when one man gets it, all the rest cease.
units.literal: Zhicai alone said: "A thousand men chase a hare; when one man gets it, all the rest cease.

units.zh: 須定大業，何容翻欲學人。」
units.en: The great enterprise must be settled—how can you turn about and wish to learn from others?"
units.literal: The great enterprise must be settled—how can you turn about and wish to learn from others?"

units.zh: 又援引證據，備有條目，帝從之。
units.en: He also cited evidence, fully itemized; the emperor followed him.
units.literal: He also cited evidence, fully itemized; the emperor followed him.

units.zh: 登祚後，彌見親密。
units.en: After he ascended the throne, intimacy grew still closer.
units.literal: After he ascended the throne, intimacy grew still closer.

units.zh: 之才非唯醫術自進，亦為首唱禪代，又戲謔滑稽，言無不至，於是大被狎昵。
units.en: Zhicai advanced not only through medical skill; he was also foremost in urging the abdication, and again he jested with wit and buffoonery, speaking without reserve—therefore he was greatly favored and familiar.
units.literal: Zhicai advanced not only through medical skill; he was also foremost in urging the abdication, and again he jested with wit and buffoonery, speaking without reserve—therefore he was greatly favored and familiar.

units.zh: 尋除侍中，封池陽縣伯。
units.en: Before long he was appointed palace attendant and enfeoffed as earl of Chiyang county.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Palace Attendant and enfeoffed as Earl of Chiyang county.

units.zh: 見文宣政令轉嚴，求出，除趙州刺史，竟不獲述職，猶為弄臣。
units.en: When he saw Emperor Wenxuan's rule turning harsh he asked to leave the capital. He was made inspector of Zhao province but never took up the post and remained a court buffoon.
units.literal: Seeing Emperor Wenxuan's edicts grow ever stricter, he sought to leave office; he was appointed Inspector of Zhao province, yet never took up the post and remained a court jester.

units.zh: 皇建二年，除西兗州刺史。
units.en: In the second year of Huangjian he was appointed inspector of Western Yan province.
units.literal: In Huangjian year 2 he was appointed Inspector of Western Yan province.

units.zh: 未之官，武明皇太后不豫，之才療之，應手便愈，孝昭賜采帛千段、錦四百疋。
units.en: He had not yet gone to his post when Empress Dowager Wuming fell ill. Zhicai treated her and she recovered at once. Emperor Xiaozhao rewarded him with a thousand rolls of silk and four hundred bolts of brocade.
units.literal: Before he took office, Empress Dowager Wuming fell ill; Zhicai treated her and she recovered at once; Emperor Xiaozhao gave a thousand rolls of colored silk and four hundred bolts of brocade.

units.zh: 之才旣善醫術，雖有外授，頃卽徵還。
units.en: Because his medical skill was outstanding, though he was granted an outside post he was recalled within a short time.
units.literal: Zhicai being skilled in medicine, though given an external appointment, he was soon recalled.

units.zh: 旣博識多聞，由是於方術尤妙。
units.en: He was widely read and well informed, and on that account became especially skilled in prognostication and the occult arts.
units.literal: Being broadly learned and well informed, he became especially adept in the arts of occult calculation.

units.zh: 大寧二年春，武明太后又病。
units.en: In the spring of the second year of Daning the empress dowager Wuming fell ill again.
units.literal: In spring of the second year of Daning, Empress Dowager Wuming fell ill again.

units.zh: 之才弟之範為尚藥典御，勑令診候。
units.en: Zhicai's younger brother Zhifan was director of the imperial pharmacy and was ordered to examine and treat her.
units.literal: Zhicai's younger brother Zhifan was Director of the Imperial Pharmacy; he was ordered to examine and attend her.

units.zh: 內史皆令呼太后為石婆，蓋有俗忌，故改名以厭制之。
units.en: The inner officials all had the empress dowager addressed as "Stone Granny," a folk taboo-name meant to turn aside misfortune.
units.literal: The inner officials all ordered that the empress dowager be called Stone Granny; there was a popular taboo, so they changed her name to ward it off.

units.zh: 之範出告之才曰：「童謠雲：『周裏跂求伽，豹祠嫁石婆，斬冢作媒人，唯得一量紫綖靴。』
units.en: Zhifan came out and told Zhicai, "A children's rhyme says: 'Within Zhou, Qiqiu Jia; at Leopard Shrine they wed Stone Granny; Cut-grave serves as matchmaker—you get only a measure of purple silk boots.'
units.literal: Zhifan came out and told Zhicai, "A children's rhyme runs: 'Within Zhou, Qiqiu Jia; at Leopard Shrine a bride for Stone Granny; Cut-grave as matchmaker—only a measure of purple silk boots.'

units.zh: 今太后忽改名，私所致怪。」
units.en: Now the empress dowager has suddenly been renamed—that is a private act that invites ill omens."
units.literal: Now the empress dowager has suddenly had her name changed—this is a private act that invites the strange."

units.zh: 之才曰：「跂求伽，胡言去已。
units.en: Zhicai said, "Qiqiu Jia is Hu speech for already gone.
units.literal: Zhicai said, "Qiqiu Jia—in Hu speech, already gone.

units.zh: 豹祠嫁石婆，豈有好事？
units.en: Leopard Shrine weds Stone Granny—can that portend anything good?
units.literal: Leopard Shrine weds Stone Granny—can that be anything good?

units.zh: 斬冢作媒人，但令合葬自斬冢。
units.en: Cut-grave as matchmaker—read it as joint burial arising from the grave.
units.literal: Cut-grave as matchmaker—only let joint burial come from Cut-grave.

units.zh: 唯得紫綖靴者，得至四月，何者？
units.en: Only a measure of purple silk boots—she will reach the fourth month. How do I know?
units.literal: Only purple silk boots—she will reach the fourth month; how so?

units.zh: 紫之為字『此』下『系』，『延』者熟，當在四月之中。」
units.en: The character for purple is ci with thread below; yan means ripe. The omen falls in the middle of the fourth month."
units.literal: The character for purple is ci with thread beneath; yan means ripe—it should fall within the fourth month."

units.zh: 之範問靴是何義。
units.en: Zhifan asked what the boots signified.
units.literal: Zhifan asked what the boots meant.

units.zh: 之才曰：「靴者革旁化，寧是久物？」
units.en: Zhicai said, "Boots: beside 'leather' stands 'transform.' How could that be something that lasts?"
units.literal: Zhicai said, "Boots—beside leather stands 'transform'; how could they be a lasting thing?"

units.zh: 至四月一日，后果崩。
units.en: On the first day of the fourth month the empress dowager died, just as he had said.
units.literal: On the first day of the fourth month the empress dowager indeed died.

units.zh: 有人患腳跟腫痛，諸醫莫能識。
units.en: A man suffered swollen, painful heels, and no physician could name the disease.
units.literal: Someone suffered swollen, painful heels; no physician could identify the ailment.

units.zh: 之才曰：「蛤精疾也，由乘船入海，垂腳水中。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "This is clam-spirit sickness, contracted by sailing the sea and dangling his feet in the water."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "It is clam-spirit sickness, from taking a boat to sea and letting his feet hang in the water."

units.zh: 疾者曰：「實曾如此。」
units.en: The patient said, "That is exactly what I did."
units.literal: The patient said, "That is indeed what happened."

units.zh: 之才為剖得蛤子二，大如榆莢。
units.en: Zhicai cut him open and took out two clam embryos, each as large as an elm pod.
units.literal: Zhicai cut him open and removed two clam embryos, each as large as an elm pod.

units.zh: 又有以骨為刀子靶者，五色班斕。
units.en: Another man had made a knife handle from bone, five-colored and streaked.
units.literal: Another man used bone for a knife handle, five-colored and variegated.

units.zh: 之才曰：「此人瘤也。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "This man has a tumor."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "This man has a tumor."

units.zh: 問得處，云於古冢見髑髏額骨長數寸，試削視，有文理，故用之。
units.en: Asked where he had found it, he said that in an old tomb he had seen a skull whose forehead bone was several inches long; he shaved it and found a grain in the bone, so he used it.
units.literal: Asked where he had got it, he said that in an ancient tomb he had seen a skull whose forehead bone was several inches long; he tried shaving it and found a grain, so he used it.

units.zh: 其明悟多通如此。
units.en: His keen insight and wide mastery ran to such cases.
units.literal: His keen insight and wide mastery were like this.

units.zh: 天統四年，累遷尚書左僕射，俄除兗州刺史，特給鐃吹一部。
units.en: In the fourth year of Tiantong he rose in steps to left vice director of the imperial secretariat, then was made inspector of Yan province with a special grant of one suite of drums and pipes.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tiantong he was promoted in succession to Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat; soon he was made Inspector of Yan province, with a special grant of one set of drums and pipes.

units.zh: 之才醫術最高，偏被命召。
units.en: Zhicai's medical skill stood above all others, and he alone was repeatedly summoned by imperial order.
units.literal: Zhicai's medical skill was supreme, and he alone was repeatedly summoned by imperial order.

units.zh: 武成酒色過度，怳惚不恒，曾病發，自雲初見空中有五色物，稍近，變成一美婦人，去地數丈，亭亭而立。
units.en: Emperor Wucheng indulged wine and women beyond measure and was often dazed and unsteady. Once when his illness flared he said that at first he saw a five-colored thing in the air; as it drew nearer it became a beautiful woman standing several zhang above the ground, upright and still.
units.literal: Emperor Wucheng indulged wine and women to excess and was often dazed and unsteady; once when his illness flared he himself said that at first he saw a five-colored thing in the air; as it drew nearer it turned into a beautiful woman standing several zhang above the ground, upright and poised.

units.zh: 食頃，變為觀世音。
units.en: After the time it takes to eat a meal it turned into Guanyin.
units.literal: After the time it takes to eat, it turned into Guanyin.

units.zh: 之才云：「此色欲多，大虛所致。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "This comes from excessive lust and great depletion of the vital principle."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "This comes from excessive lust and great depletion of the vital principle."

units.zh: 卽處湯方，服一劑，便覺稍遠，又服，還變成五色物，數劑湯，疾竟愈。
units.en: He immediately prepared a decoction. After one dose the vision drew farther away; after another it turned back into a five-colored thing; after several doses the illness was wholly cured.
units.literal: He immediately prepared a decoction; after one dose the vision drew somewhat farther off; after another dose it turned back into a five-colored thing; after several doses of the broth the illness was wholly cured.

units.zh: 帝每發動，輒遣騎追之，針藥所加，應時必效，故頻有端執之舉。
units.en: Whenever the emperor's illness flared he sent riders to fetch Zhicai; needles and drugs applied on the spot always worked at once, so Zhicai was often kept in attendance at the bedside.
units.literal: Whenever the emperor's illness flared he would send horsemen in pursuit of Zhicai; needles and drugs applied at once always took effect, so there were frequent occasions when Zhicai stood in attendance at the bedside.

units.zh: 入秋，武成小定，更不發動。
units.en: When autumn came Emperor Wucheng grew somewhat settled and no longer suffered flare-ups.
units.literal: When autumn came Emperor Wucheng grew somewhat settled and no longer suffered flare-ups.

units.zh: 和士開欲依次轉進，以之才附籍兗州，卽是本屬，遂奏附除刺史，以胡長仁為左僕射，士開為右僕射。
units.en: He Shikai wished to advance in regular order. Because Zhicai's household register was attached to Yan province, which was his home jurisdiction, he memorialized that Zhicai be sent out as inspector there, with Hu Changren as left vice director and He Shikai as right vice director.
units.literal: He Shikai wished to advance in regular order; because Zhicai's household register was attached to Yan province, which was his native jurisdiction, he memorialized that Zhicai be additionally appointed inspector there, with Hu Changren as Left Vice Director and He Shikai as Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 及十月，帝又病動，語士開云：「恨用之才外任，使我辛苦。」
units.en: In the tenth month the emperor's illness flared again. He told He Shikai, "I regret sending Zhicai out to a provincial post—it has made me suffer."
units.literal: In the tenth month the emperor's illness flared again; he told He Shikai, "I regret sending Zhicai out on an external post—it has made me suffer."

units.zh: 其月八日，勑驛追之才。
units.en: On the eighth day of that month an edict went out by post relay to recall Zhicai.
units.literal: On the eighth day of that month an edict went out by post relay to recall Zhicai.

units.zh: 帝以十日崩，之才十一日方到。
units.en: The emperor died on the tenth; Zhicai did not arrive until the eleventh.
units.literal: The emperor died on the tenth; Zhicai did not arrive until the eleventh.

units.zh: 旣無所及，復還赴州。
units.en: There was nothing left for him to do, and he returned to his provincial post.
units.literal: There was nothing left to do; he returned to take up his provincial post.

units.zh: 在職無所侵暴，但不甚閑法理，頗亦疏慢，用捨自由。
units.en: In office he committed no oppression or violence, but he was not well versed in law and was rather negligent and casual, appointing and dismissing as he pleased.
units.literal: In office he committed no oppression or violence, but he was not very versed in law and was rather negligent and casual, doing as he pleased in appointments and dismissals.

units.zh: 五年冬，後王徵之才。
units.en: In the winter of the fifth year the last ruler summoned Zhicai.
units.literal: In the winter of the fifth year the Last Ruler summoned Zhicai.

units.zh: 尋左僕射闕，之才曰：「自可復禹之績。」
units.en: Soon the left vice directorship fell vacant. Zhicai said, "Surely I can repeat Yu's achievement."
units.literal: Soon the left vice directorship fell vacant; Zhicai said, "I can surely repeat Yu's achievement."

units.zh: 武平元年，重除尚書左僕射。
units.en: In the first year of Wuping he was again appointed left vice director of the imperial secretariat.
units.literal: In the first year of Wuping he was again appointed Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

units.zh: 之才於和士開、陸令萱母子曲盡卑狎，二家苦疾，救護百端。
units.en: Toward He Shikai and Lu Lingxuan, mother and son, Zhicai was utterly obsequious and familiar; when the two households fell gravely ill he contrived a hundred ways to save them.
units.literal: Zhicai toward He Shikai and Lu Lingxuan mother and son was utterly obsequious and familiar; when the two households fell gravely ill he contrived a hundred ways to save them.

units.zh: 由是遷尚書令，封西陽郡王。
units.en: On that account he was promoted to director of the imperial secretariat and enfeoffed as prince of Xiyang commandery.
units.literal: On that account he was promoted to Director of the Imperial Secretariat and enfeoffed as Prince of Xiyang commandery.

units.zh: 祖珽執政，除之才侍中、太子太師。
units.en: When Zu Ting held power he appointed Zhicai attendant-in-ordinary and grand tutor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: When Zu Ting held power he appointed Zhicai Attendant-in-Ordinary and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 之才恨曰：「子野沙汰我。」
units.en: Zhicai said resentfully, "Ziye has winnowed me out."
units.literal: Zhicai said resentfully, "Ziye has winnowed me out."

units.zh: 珽目疾，故以師曠比之。
units.en: Ting suffered from an eye ailment, so Zhicai compared him to Music Master Kuang.
units.literal: Ting had an eye ailment, so he was compared to Music Master Kuang.

units.zh: 之才聰辨強識，有兼人之敏，尤好劇談謔語，公私言聚，多相嘲戲。
units.en: Zhicai was clever in debate and had a strong memory, with more than ordinary quickness. He especially loved witty talk and raillery; at public and private gatherings people often mocked one another in sport.
units.literal: Zhicai was clever in debate and had a strong memory, with more than ordinary quickness; he especially loved witty talk and raillery, and in public and private gatherings people often mocked one another in sport.

units.zh: 鄭道育常戲之才為師公。
units.en: Zheng Daoyu often jested that Zhicai was "Master-and-Duke."
units.literal: Zheng Daoyu often jested that Zhicai was Master-and-Duke.

units.zh: 之才曰：「旣為汝師，又為汝公，在三之義，頓居其兩。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "Since I am your teacher and also your duke, among the Three Bonds I suddenly hold two of the roles."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "Since I am your teacher and also your duke, in the Three Bonds I suddenly hold two of the roles."

units.zh: 又嘲王昕姓云：「有言則訁王，近犬便狂，加頸足而為馬，施角尾而為羊。」
units.en: He also mocked Wang Xin's surname, saying, "Add the speech radical and it becomes 訁王; put it near dog and it becomes 狂; add neck and legs and it becomes 馬; give it horns and a tail and it becomes 羊."
units.literal: He also mocked Wang Xin's surname, saying, "Add the speech radical and it becomes 訁王; put it near dog and it becomes 狂; add neck and legs and it becomes 馬; give it horns and a tail and it becomes 羊."

units.zh: 盧元明因戲之才云：「卿姓是未入人，名是字之誤，『之』當為『乏』也。」
units.en: Lu Yuanming jested with Zhicai, "Your surname means not yet entered among men; your given name is a mistaken character, for zhi should be fa, lack."
units.literal: Lu Yuanming jested with Zhicai, "Your surname means not yet entered among men; your given name is a mistaken character, for zhi should be fa, lack."

units.zh: 卽答云：「卿姓在亡為虐，在丘為虛，生男則為虜，養馬則為驢。」
units.en: He answered at once, "Your surname with death added is tyrant; on a mound it is void; if you bear a son he is a captive; if you raise a horse it is an ass."
units.literal: He answered at once, "Your surname with death added is tyrant; on a mound it is void; if you bear a son he is a captive; if you raise a horse it is an ass."

units.zh: 又嘗與朝士出遊，遙望群犬競走，諸人試令目之。
units.en: He also once went out with court gentlemen and from afar saw a pack of dogs racing.
units.literal: He also once went out with court gentlemen; from afar they saw a pack of dogs racing.

units.zh: 之才卽應聲云：「為是宋鵲，為是韓盧，為逐李斯東走，為負帝女南徂。」
units.en: The others asked him to name them on sight. Zhicai answered at once, "Are they Song Que or Han Lu—or chasing Li Si eastward, or carrying the Emperor's Daughter south?"
units.literal: The others tried to have him name them on sight; Zhicai answered at once, "Are they Song Que, or Han Lu—or chasing Li Si eastward, or carrying the Emperor's Daughter south?"

units.zh: 李諧於廣坐，因稱其父名曰：「卿嗜熊白生否？」
units.en: At a great gathering Li He invoked his father's name and said, "Do you like raw bear's paw?"
units.literal: Li He at a great gathering invoked his father's name and said, "Do you like raw bear's paw?"

units.zh: 之才曰：「平平耳。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "So-so."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "So-so."

units.zh: 又曰：「卿此言於理平否？」
units.en: He also said, "Is what you said logically fair?"
units.literal: He also said, "Is what you said logically fair?"

units.zh: 諧遽出避之，道逢其甥高德正。
units.en: He fled at once to avoid him. On the road he met his nephew Gao Dezheng.
units.literal: He fled at once to avoid him; on the road he met his nephew Gao Dezheng.

units.zh: 德正曰：「舅顏色何不悅？」
units.en: Dezheng said, "Uncle, why do you look displeased?"
units.literal: Dezheng said, "Uncle, why is your face not pleased?"

units.zh: 諧告之故。
units.en: He told him the reason.
units.literal: He told him the reason.

units.zh: 德正徑造坐席，連索熊白。
units.en: Dezheng went straight to the gathering and repeatedly demanded bear's paw.
units.literal: Dezheng went straight to the seat and repeatedly demanded bear's paw.

units.zh: 之才謂坐者曰：「箇人諱底？」
units.en: Zhicai said to those seated, "Whose taboo is it?"
units.literal: Zhicai said to those seated, "Whose taboo is it?"

units.zh: 衆莫知。
units.en: No one knew.
units.literal: No one knew.

units.zh: 之才曰：「生不為人所知，死不為人所諱，此何足問？」
units.en: Zhicai said, "Alive he was unknown to others; dead he is not tabooed to others—why is that worth asking?"
units.literal: Zhicai said, "Alive he was unknown to others; dead he is not tabooed to others—why should that be worth asking?"

units.zh: 唐邕、白建方貴，時人言云：「幷州赫赫唐與白。」
units.en: Tang Yong and Bai Jian were then in high favor; people said, "In Bingzhou, Tang and Bai blaze bright."
units.literal: Tang Yong and Bai Jian were then in high favor; people said, "In Bingzhou, Tang and Bai blaze bright."

units.zh: 之才蔑之。
units.en: Zhicai despised them.
units.literal: Zhicai despised them.

units.zh: 元日，對邕為諸令史祝曰：「見卿等位當作唐、白。」
units.en: On New Year's Day, facing Yong, he said to the clerks in blessing, "May you gentlemen in rank become Tang and Bai."
units.literal: On New Year's Day, facing Yong, he said to the clerks in blessing, "May you gentlemen in rank become Tang and Bai."

units.zh: 又以小史好嚼筆，故嘗執管就元文遙口曰：「借君齒。」
units.en: Because a junior clerk liked to chew his brush, he once held the tube to Yuan Wenyao's mouth and said, "Lend me your teeth."
units.literal: Because a junior clerk liked to chew his brush, he once held the tube to Yuan Wenyao's mouth and said, "Lend me your teeth."

units.zh: 其不遜如此。
units.en: His insolence ran to such lengths.
units.literal: His insolence was like this.

units.zh: 歷事諸帝，以戲狎得寵。
units.en: Serving several emperors, he won favor through jesting familiarity.
units.literal: Serving several emperors, he won favor through jesting familiarity.

units.zh: 武成生齻牙，問諸醫。
units.en: Emperor Wucheng had buck teeth and asked the physicians about them.
units.literal: Emperor Wucheng had buck teeth; he asked the physicians.

units.zh: 尚藥典御鄧宣文以實對，武成怒而撻之。
units.en: Director of the imperial pharmacy Deng Xuanwen answered truthfully; Wucheng in anger had him flogged.
units.literal: Director of the Imperial Pharmacy Deng Xuanwen answered truthfully; Wucheng in anger had him flogged.

units.zh: 後以問之才，拜賀曰：「此是智牙，生智牙者聰明長壽。」
units.en: Later he asked Zhicai, who bowed in congratulation and said, "These are wisdom teeth; one who grows wisdom teeth is clever and long-lived."
units.literal: Later he asked Zhicai, who bowed in congratulation and said, "These are wisdom teeth; one who grows wisdom teeth is clever and long-lived."

units.zh: 武成悅而賞之。
units.en: Wucheng was pleased and rewarded him.
units.literal: Wucheng was pleased and rewarded him.

units.zh: 為僕射時，語人曰：「我在江東，見徐勉作僕射，朝士莫不佞之。
units.en: When he was vice director he told people, "In the southeast I saw Xu Mian serve as vice director, and no court gentleman failed to flatter him.
units.literal: When he was vice director he said to people, "In the southeast I saw Xu Mian serve as vice director, and no court gentleman failed to flatter him.

units.zh: 今我亦是徐僕射，無一人佞我，何由可活！」
units.en: Now I too am Vice Director Xu—yet not one person flatters me. How am I to live!"
units.literal: Now I too am Vice Director Xu—yet not one person flatters me. How am I to live!"

units.zh: 之才妻魏廣陽王妹，之才從文襄求得為妻。
units.en: Zhicai's wife was a sister of the prince of Guangyang of Wei; Zhicai had obtained her as wife through Gao Cheng.
units.literal: Zhicai's wife was a sister of the Prince of Guangyang of Wei; Zhicai had obtained her as wife through Gao Cheng.

units.zh: 和士開知之，乃淫其妻。
units.en: He Shikai learned of this and violated his wife.
units.literal: He Shikai learned of this and violated his wife.

units.zh: 之才遇見而避之，退曰：「妨少年戲笑。」
units.en: Zhicai happened upon them and avoided them. He withdrew and said, "I am hindering the young man's sport."
units.literal: Zhicai happened upon them and avoided them; he withdrew and said, "I am hindering the young man's sport."

units.zh: 其寬縱如此。
units.en: His indulgence ran to such lengths.
units.literal: His indulgence was like this.

units.zh: 年八十，卒。
units.en: He died at the age of eighty.
units.literal: He died at the age of eighty.

units.zh: 贈司徒公、錄尚書事，諡曰文明。
units.en: He was posthumously made duke of the state of Situ and recorder of affairs of the imperial secretariat, with the posthumous title Civil and Bright.
units.literal: He was posthumously made Duke of the State of Situ and Recorder of Affairs of the Imperial Secretariat, with the posthumous title Civil and Bright.

units.zh: 長子林，字少卿，太尉司馬。
units.en: The eldest son Lin, style Shaoqing, was marshal of the grand commandant.
units.literal: The eldest son Lin, style name Shaoqing, was a marshal of the Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 次子同卿，太子庶子，之才以其無學術，每嘆云雲：「終恐同《廣陵散》矣。」
units.en: The second son Tongqing was a household attendant of the heir apparent. Because Tongqing had no learning, Zhicai often sighed and said, "In the end I fear he will share the fate of the Guangling melody."
units.literal: The second son Tongqing was a household attendant of the heir apparent; Zhicai, because he had no learning, often sighed and said, "In the end I fear he will share the fate of the Guangling melody."

units.zh: 弟之範，亦醫術見知，位太常卿，特聽襲之才爵西陽王。
units.en: His younger brother Zhifan was also known for medical skill. He reached minister of ceremonies and was specially permitted to inherit Zhicai's title as prince of Xiyang.
units.literal: The younger brother Zhifan was also known for medical skill; he reached Minister of Ceremonies and was specially permitted to inherit Zhicai's title as Prince of Xiyang.

units.zh: 入周，授儀同大將軍。
units.en: After entering Zhou he was appointed general of the household with insignia equal to three offices.
units.literal: After entering Zhou he was appointed General of the Household with Insignia Equal to Three Offices.

units.zh: 開皇中卒。
units.en: He died in the Kaihuang era.
units.literal: He died in the Kaihuang era.

units.zh: 武成使元文遙就州宣勑曰：「馮翊王少小謹慎，在州不為非法，朕信之熟矣。
units.en: Gao Zhan sent Yuan Wenyao with an edict: "Prince Run has been careful from youth and committed no crime in office — I know him thoroughly.
units.literal: Wucheng sent Yuan Wenyao to the province with an edict, saying, "Prince of Fengyi Run has been careful from youth; at his post he has committed no wrong — I know him well.

units.zh: 三月，齊遣其上黨王高渙送貞陽侯蕭淵明來主梁嗣，至東關，遣吳興太守裴之橫與戰，敗績，之橫死。
units.en: In the third month Qi sent Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan to escort Zhenyang marquis Xiao Yuanming to take the Liang succession; at Dong Pass Wuxing administrator Pei Zhiheng fought them and was defeated and killed.
units.literal: In the third month, Qi sent its Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan to escort Marquis of Zhenyang Xiao Yuanming to assume the Liang succession; reaching Dong Pass, they sent Wuxing Administrator Pei Zhiheng to fight; defeated in battle, Zhiheng died.

units.zh: 先是，南北初和，李諧、盧元明首通使命，二人才器，並為鄰國所重。
units.en: When north and south first made peace, Li Xie and Lu Yuanming were the pioneering envoys, and both were held in high regard across the border.
units.literal: Before this, when north and south first made peace, Li Xie and Lu Yuanming first carried missions; the two men's talents and capacity were both held in esteem by the neighboring state.

units.zh: 韋粲 江子一 弟子四 子五 張嵊 沈浚 柳敬禮
units.en: Wei Can; Jiang Ziyi; his younger brothers Zisi and Ziwu; Zhang Sheng; Shen Jun; Liu Jingli
units.literal: Wei Can; Jiang Ziyi; younger brother Zisi; younger brother Ziwu; Zhang Sheng; Shen Jun; Liu Jingli

units.zh: 張嵊字四山，鎮北將軍稷之子也。
units.en: Zhang Sheng, styled Sishan, was son of Pacifying North General Ji.
units.literal: Zhang Sheng, courtesy name Sishan, was son of Pacifying North General Ji.

units.zh: 及破張嵊，乃求浚以害之。
units.en: When Zhang Sheng was defeated he asked for Jun to kill him.
units.literal: When Zhang Sheng was defeated he asked for Jun to kill him.

units.zh: 至如張嵊二三子之徒，捐軀殉節，赴死如歸，英風勁氣，籠罩今古，君子知梁代之有忠臣焉。
units.en: Men such as Zhang Sheng and the two or three like him gave their bodies and died for integrity, going to death like returning home—their heroic wind and firm spirit cover past and present; the gentleman knows the Liang had loyal ministers.
units.literal: As for men such as Zhang Sheng and the two or three like him, who gave their bodies and died for integrity, going to death like returning home—their heroic wind and firm spirit cover past and present; the gentleman knows the Liang had loyal ministers.

units.zh: 父臨青州，爲土民所害，嵊感家禍，終身蔬食布衣，手不執刀刃。
units.en: His father while inspecting Qing province was killed by locals; Sheng, moved by the family calamity, ate vegetables and wore cloth all his life and never held a blade.
units.literal: His father while inspecting Qing province was killed by the local people; Sheng, moved by the family calamity, ate vegetables and wore cloth all his life and never held a blade in his hand.

units.zh: 太清二年，侯景圍京城，嵊遣弟伊率郡兵數千人赴援。
units.en: In the second year of Supreme Purity Hou Jing besieged the capital; Sheng sent his younger brother Yi to lead several thousand commandery troops to the rescue.
units.literal: In the second year of Supreme Purity Hou Jing besieged the capital; Sheng sent his younger brother Yi to lead several thousand commandery troops to the rescue.

units.zh: 嵊往見而謂曰：「賊臣憑陵，社稷危恥，正是人臣效命之秋。
units.en: Sheng went to see him and said, "The traitor towers over us; the altars are in peril—this is the season for ministers to devote their lives.
units.literal: Sheng went to see him and said: "The traitor minister towers over us; the altars are in peril and shame—this is the season for ministers to devote their lives.

units.zh: 固勸嵊舉義。
units.en: He firmly urged Sheng to raise righteousness.
units.literal: He firmly urged Sheng to raise righteousness.

units.zh: 時邵陵王東奔至錢唐，聞之，遣板授嵊征東將軍，加秩中二千石。
units.en: The Prince of Shaoling had fled east to Qiantang; hearing of it he sent a commission appointing Sheng General Who Pacifies the East with rank equal to two thousand shi.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Shaoling had fled east to Qiantang; hearing of it he sent a commission appointing Sheng General Who Pacifies the East with rank equal to two thousand shi.

units.zh: 嵊曰：「朝廷危迫，天子蒙塵，今日何情，復受榮號。」
units.en: Sheng said, "The court is in peril and the Son of Heaven suffers dust—what heart today for glory and title."
units.literal: Sheng said: "The court is in peril and the Son of Heaven suffers dust—what heart today for receiving glory and title."

units.zh: 賊行台劉神茂攻破義興，遣使說嵊曰：「若早降附，當還以郡相處，復加爵賞。」
units.en: The bandit field headquarters Liu Shenmao took Yixing and sent a messenger persuading Sheng, "If you surrender early, you will be returned the commandery to govern and receive enfeoffment and reward."
units.literal: The bandit's field headquarters Liu Shenmao took Yixing and sent a messenger persuading Sheng: "If you surrender early, you will be returned the commandery to govern and further receive enfeoffment and reward."

units.zh: 嵊命斬其使，仍遣軍主王雄等帥兵於鱧瀆逆擊之，破神茂，神茂退走。
units.en: Sheng ordered the messenger beheaded and sent commander Wang Xiong and others to meet the attack at Lüdu, defeated Shenmao, and Shenmao retreated.
units.literal: Sheng ordered the messenger beheaded and sent the commander Wang Xiong and others with troops to meet the attack at Lüdu, defeated Shenmao, and Shenmao retreated.

units.zh: 侯景聞神茂敗，乃遣其中軍侯子鑒帥精兵二萬人，助神茂以擊嵊。
units.en: Hou Jing heard Shenmao was defeated and sent his central army Hou Zijian with twenty thousand crack troops to help Shenmao attack Sheng.
units.literal: Hou Jing heard Shenmao was defeated and sent his central army Hou Zijian with twenty thousand crack troops to help Shenmao attack Sheng.

units.zh: 嵊遣軍主范智朗出郡西拒戰，爲神茂所敗，退歸。
units.en: Sheng sent commander Fan Zhilang west of the commandery to meet battle, was defeated by Shenmao, and withdrew.
units.literal: Sheng sent the commander Fan Zhilang west of the commandery to meet battle, was defeated by Shenmao, and withdrew.

units.zh: 嵊乃釋戎服，坐於聽事，賊臨之以刃，終不爲屈。
units.en: Sheng put off military dress and sat in the audience hall; the bandit held blades to him and he was never bent.
units.literal: Sheng then put off military dress and sat in the audience hall; the bandit held blades to him and he was never bent.

units.zh: 乃執嵊以送景，景刑之於都市，子弟同遇害者十餘人，時年六十二。
units.en: They seized Sheng and sent him to Jing; Jing executed him in the market, and sons and brothers who suffered with him numbered more than ten—he was sixty-two.
units.literal: They seized Sheng and sent him to Jing; Jing executed him in the market, and sons and younger brothers who suffered with him numbered more than ten—he was sixty-two.

units.zh: 諡曰忠貞子。
units.en: His posthumous title was Loyal and Upright.
units.literal: His posthumous title was Loyal and Upright.

units.zh: 起家秘書郎，累遷太子舍人、洗馬、司徒左西掾、中書郎。
units.en: He began as secretary gentleman and rose through crown prince attendant, steward, left merit officer on the Minister of Education's staff, and Secretariat gentleman.
units.literal: He began office as secretary gentleman and rose through crown prince attendant, steward, left merit officer on the Minister of Education's staff, and gentleman of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 中大同元年，徵爲太府卿，俄遷吳興太守。
units.en: In the first year of Zhongdatong he was summoned as minister of the palace treasury, soon promoted to magistrate of Wuxing.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhongdatong he was summoned as minister of the palace treasury, soon promoted to magistrate of Wuxing.

units.zh: 賊平，世祖追贈侍中、中衛將軍、開府儀同三司。
units.en: When the bandit was pacified Emperor Shizu posthumously made him palace attendant, central army commander, and Grand Master with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon with the rites of the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: When the bandit was pacified the Shizu Emperor posthumously made him palace attendant, central army commander, and Grand Master with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon with the same rites as the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 三年，宮城陷，御史中丞沈浚違難東歸。
units.en: In the third year the palace city fell; censor-in-chief Shen Jun fled east in hardship.
units.literal: In the third year the palace city fell; censor-in-chief Shen Jun fled east in hardship.

units.zh: 州舉秀才。
units.en: The province nominated him as Presented Scholar.
units.literal: The province nominated him as Presented Scholar.

units.zh: 於是收集士卒，繕築城壘。
units.en: Thereupon he gathered soldiers and repaired walls and ramparts.
units.literal: Thereupon he gathered soldiers and repaired walls and ramparts.

units.zh: 今欲收集兵力，保據貴鄉。
units.en: Now I wish to gather troops and hold your noble district.
units.literal: Now I wish to gather troops and hold your noble district.

units.zh: 若天道無靈，忠節不展，雖復及死，誠亦無恨。」
units.en: If Heaven is without spirit and loyal resolve cannot unfold, even if death follows, I have no regret."
units.literal: If Heaven's way is without spirit and loyal resolve cannot unfold, even if death follows, truly I have no regret."

units.zh: 太子意以爲疑，命僕劉孝綽議其事。
units.en: The crown prince found this doubtful and ordered his secretary Liu Xiaochuo to deliberate it.
units.literal: The crown prince thought this doubtful and ordered his secretary Liu Xiaochuo to deliberate the matter.

units.zh: 孝綽議曰：「案張鏡撰《東宮儀記》，稱『三朝發哀者，逾月不舉樂；
units.en: Xiaochuo wrote: "Zhang Jing's Eastern Palace Ritual Record says, 'For mourning begun at the three audiences, for more than a month music is not performed;
units.literal: Xiaochuo's deliberation said: "According to Zhang Jing's compilation Eastern Palace Ritual Record, it states, 'For those who begin mourning at the three audiences, for more than a month music is not performed;

units.zh: 僕射徐勉、左率周舍、家令陸襄並同孝綽議。
units.en: Vice Director Xu Mian, Left Leader Zhou She, and Household Intendant Lu Xiang all sided with Xiaochuo.
units.literal: Vice Director Xu Mian, Left Leader Zhou She, and Household Intendant Lu Xiang all agreed with Xiaochuo's deliberation.

units.zh: 鼓吹寢奏，服限亦然』。
units.en: drums and pipes cease, and the dress limit is the same.'"
units.literal: drums and pipes cease performance, and the limit on dress is likewise.'"

units.zh: 尋傍絕之義，義在去服，服雖可奪，情豈無悲？
units.en: The sense of severing collateral kin is that mourning dress ends; dress may be removed, but feeling cannot be stripped of grief.
units.literal: Seeking the meaning of cutting off collateral kin, the meaning lies in removing mourning dress; dress may be stripped away, but can feeling be without grief?

units.zh: 鐃歌輟奏，良亦爲此。
units.en: Halting gongs and songs is truly for this reason as well.
units.literal: The striking of gongs and songs ceasing performance is truly also for this.

units.zh: 旣有悲情，宜稱兼慕，卒哭之後，依常舉樂，稱悲竟，此理例相符。
units.en: Where grief remains, one should call it combined mourning; after the wailing sacrifice music may resume as usual, grief being ended—principle and precedent agree.
units.literal: Since there is feeling of grief, one should style it "combined mourning"; after the wailing sacrifice, follow custom in performing music, calling grief ended—this principle and precedent accord.

units.zh: 謂猶應稱兼慕，至卒哭。」
units.en: He held that combined mourning should still be named until the wailing sacrifice."
units.literal: It is held that one should still style it combined mourning until the wailing sacrifice."

units.zh: 三年十一月，始興王憺薨。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year three Prince Dan of Shixing died.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year, Prince Dan of Shixing died.

units.zh: 劉僕議，云『傍絕之義，義在去服，服雖可奪，情豈無悲，卒哭之後，依常舉樂，稱悲竟，此理例相符』。
units.en: Secretary Liu says, 'Severing collateral kin means mourning dress ends; dress may go, but grief cannot; after the wailing sacrifice music resumes as usual, grief ended—principle and precedent agree.'"
units.literal: Secretary Liu's deliberation says, 'The meaning of cutting off collateral kin lies in removing mourning dress; dress may be stripped away, but can feeling be without grief? After the wailing sacrifice, follow custom in performing music, calling grief ended—this principle and precedent accord.'"

units.zh: 劉僕射之議，卽情未安。
units.en: Vice Director Liu's view leaves feeling uneasy.
units.literal: Vice Director Liu's deliberation—feeling is not at ease.

units.zh: 初，蕭詧定州刺史田龍升以城降，詔以為振遠將軍、定州刺史，封赤亭王。
units.en: Earlier Tian Longsheng, inspector of Dingzhou under Xiao Cha, had surrendered his city; an edict made him General Who Invigorates the Distant and inspector of Dingzhou, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Chiting.
units.literal: Earlier, Xiao Cha's Inspector of Dingzhou Tian Longsheng had surrendered his city; an edict appointed him General Who Invigorates the Distant and Inspector of Dingzhou, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Chiting.

units.zh: 及帝將建中宮，高隆之、高德正言漢婦人不可為天下母，宜更擇美配。
units.en: When the emperor was about to establish the central palace, Gao Longzhi and Gao Dezheng said a Han woman could not be mother to the realm and that a more beautiful match should be chosen.
units.literal: When the emperor was about to establish the central palace, Gao Longzhi and Gao Dezheng said a Han woman could not be mother to the realm and that a more beautiful match should be chosen.

units.zh: 而德正猶固請廢后而立段昭儀，欲以結勳貴之援，帝竟不從而立后焉。
units.en: Yet Dezheng still firmly asked to depose the empress and install Lady Duan as Honored Consort, wishing thereby to win the support of meritorious nobles; the emperor in the end did not follow him and established the empress.
units.literal: Yet Dezheng still firmly asked to depose the empress and install Lady Duan as Honored Consort, wishing thereby to win the support of meritorious nobles; the emperor in the end did not follow him and established the empress.

units.zh: 後主皇后胡氏，隴東王長仁女也。
units.en: Empress Hu of Houzhu was the daughter of Prince Longdong Changren.
units.literal: Empress Hu of Houzhu was the daughter of Prince Longdong Changren.

units.zh: 陸媼既非勸立，又意在穆夫人，其後於太后前作色而言曰：「何物親侄女，作如此語言！」
units.en: Lu Aun, who had not supported the elevation and still favored Lady Mu, later appeared before the Empress Dowager with a dark look and said, "What sort of niece is this, to speak such words!"
units.literal: Lu Aun, who had not supported her elevation and had her heart set on Lady Mu, later appeared displeased before the Empress Dowager and said, "What sort of mere niece by blood speaks words like these!"

units.zh: 尉瑾 馮子琮 赫連子悅 唐邕 白建
units.en: Yu Jin; Feng Zicong; Helian Ziyue; Tang Yong; Bai Jian
units.literal: Yu Jin; Feng Zicong; Helian Ziyue; Tang Yong; Bai Jian

units.zh: 及天保受禪，諸司監咸歸尚書，唯此二曹不廢，令唐邕、白建主治，謂之外兵省、騎兵省。
units.en: When Tianbao received the mandate, all office supervisors went to the Masters of Writing, but these two bureaus remained; Tang Yong and Bai Jian headed them, called the External Troops Department and Cavalry Department.
units.literal: When Tianbao received the mandate, all office supervisors were folded into the Masters of Writing, but these two bureaus were not abolished; Tang Yong and Bai Jian were put in charge of them, called the External Troops Department and Cavalry Department.

units.zh: 白建，字彥舉，太原陽邑人也。
units.en: Bai Jian, styled Yansu, was from Yangyi in Taiyuan.
units.literal: Bai Jian, styled Yansu, was a native of Yangyi in Taiyuan.

units.zh: 天保十年，兼中書舍人。
units.en: In the tenth year of Tianbao he was additionally made secretariat gentleman.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Tianbao he was additionally made secretariat gentleman.

units.zh: 武平末，歷特進、侍中、中書令。
units.en: At the end of Wuping he rose through special advance, attendant-in-ordinary, and chief minister of the secretariat.
units.literal: At the end of Wuping he rose through special advance, attendant-in-ordinary, and chief minister of the secretariat.

units.zh: 屬王業始基，戎寄為重，建與唐邕俱以典執兵馬致位卿相。
units.en: As the royal enterprise was just beginning and military trust was weighty, Jian and Tang Yong both reached minister and chancellor by holding charge of troops and horses.
units.literal: As the royal enterprise was just beginning and military trust was weighty, Jian and Tang Yong both rose to minister and chancellor by keeping charge of troops and horses.

units.zh: 初入大丞相府騎兵曹，典執文帳，明解書計，為同局所推。
units.en: He first entered the grand chancellor's cavalry bureau, kept the clerical registers, understood accounts, and was promoted by colleagues in the same office.
units.literal: He first entered the Grand Chancellor's office cavalry bureau, kept charge of clerical registers, understood bookkeeping clearly, and was pushed forward by colleagues in the same office.

units.zh: 諸子幼稚，俱為州郡主簿，新君選補，必先召辟。
units.en: Though his sons were still young, all became provincial chief clerks; when the new ruler made appointments, they were always summoned first.
units.literal: Though his sons were still young, all became chief clerks in the provinces and commanderies; when the new ruler chose and appointed, they were always summoned and engaged first.

units.zh: 男婚女嫁，皆得勝流。
units.en: Sons' marriages and daughters' weddings all matched leading families.
units.literal: When sons married and daughters wed, they all won eminent company.

units.zh: 肅宗輔政，除大丞相騎兵參軍。
units.en: When Suzong was regent he was appointed cavalry adjutant in the grand chancellor's office.
units.literal: When Suzong was regent he was appointed grand chancellor's office cavalry adjutant.

units.zh: 河清三年，突厥入境，代、忻二牧悉是細馬，合數萬匹，在五臺山北栢谷中避賊。
units.en: In the third year of Heqing, when Turks raided the border, the Dai and Xin herds—all fine horses, tens of thousands together—hid from bandits in Cypress Valley north of Mount Wutai.
units.literal: In the third year of Heqing, when the Turks invaded the border, the Dai and Xin herds were all fine horses, numbering tens of thousands together; they sheltered from bandits in Cypress Valley north of Mount Wutai.

units.zh: 武平七年卒。
units.en: In the seventh year of Wuping he died.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Wuping he died.

units.zh: 賊退後，勑建就彼檢校，續使人詣建間領馬，送定州付民養飼。
units.en: After the raiders withdrew, an edict sent Jian to inspect; messengers kept coming for him to take the horses and send them to Ding Province for the people to raise.
units.literal: After the bandits retreated, an edict ordered Jian to go there and inspect; messengers were continually sent to Jian to take over the horses and deliver them to Ding Province to be given to the people for raising and feeding.

units.zh: 建以馬久不得食，瘦弱，遠送恐多死損，遂違勑以便宜從事，隨近散付軍人。
units.en: Jian judged the horses had long gone unfed and were thin; a long haul would kill many, so he disobeyed the edict, acted as expedient required, and distributed them nearby to soldiers.
units.literal: Jian judged that the horses had long gone without food and were emaciated; sending them far he feared many would die in transit; he therefore disobeyed the edict and acted on expedient grounds, dispersing and entrusting them nearby to soldiers.

units.zh: 啟知，勑許焉。
units.en: He reported; the emperor learned and approved by edict.
units.literal: He reported and the emperor learned; an edict permitted it.

units.zh: 建雖無他才，勤於在公。
units.en: Jian had no other talent but was diligent in public affairs.
units.literal: Jian had no other talent but was diligent in public duty.

units.zh: 當世以為榮寵之極。
units.en: The age took this as the height of honor and favor.
units.literal: The age regarded this as the summit of honor and favor.

units.zh: 其後邕、建位望轉隆，各為省主，令中書舍人分判二省事，故世稱唐、白云。
units.en: Later Yong and Jian rose higher; each became head of his department, with secretariat gentlemen to divide their affairs—hence the age called them Tang and Bai.
units.literal: Later Yong and Jian's standing grew ever loftier; each became head of his department; secretariat gentlemen were assigned to divide decisions on the two departments' affairs—hence the age called them Tang and Bai.

units.zh: 戎乘無損，建有力焉。
units.en: The war horses suffered no loss—Jian had credit for this.
units.literal: The war horses suffered no loss—Jian had merit in this.

units.zh: 既居樞要，又以盧元明代收為中書郎，由是收銜之。
units.en: Once he held a pivotal post, he also had Lu Yuanming replace Shou as secretariat gentleman — from this Shou bore a grudge.
units.literal: Once he held a pivotal post, he also had Lu Yuanming replace Shou as secretariat gentleman; from this Shou bore a grudge.

units.zh: 壬申，侯安都輕兵襲齊行臺司馬恭于歷陽，大破之，俘獲萬計。
units.en: On renshen Hou Andu with light troops raided Qi field headquarters Sima Gong at Liyang, routed him, and took tens of thousands captive.
units.literal: On renshen Hou Andu with light troops raided Qi field headquarters Sima Gong at Liyang, greatly defeated him, captives and booty in tens of thousands.

units.zh: 僧辯之討陸納也，申在軍中，于時賊眾奄至，左右披靡，申躬蔽僧辯，蒙楯而前，會裴之橫救至，賊乃退，僧辯顧申而笑曰：「仁者必有勇，豈虛言哉！」
units.en: When Sengbian campaigned against Lu Na, Shen was in the army; at that time the rebel masses suddenly arrived and those left and right were scattered; Shen personally shielded Sengbian, covered himself with a shield and went forward; when Pei Zhiheng's rescue arrived, the rebels withdrew. Sengbian looked back at Shen and laughed, saying, "The humane surely have courage—is this an empty saying!"
units.literal: When Sengbian campaigned against Lu Na, Shen was in the army; at that time the rebel masses suddenly arrived, those left and right were scattered; Shen personally shielded Sengbian, covered himself with a shield and went forward; when Pei Zhiheng's rescue arrived, the rebels then withdrew. Sengbian looked back at Shen and laughed, saying: "The humane surely have courage—is this an empty saying!"

units.zh: 散騎常侍徐之才、館客宋景業先為天文圖讖之學，又陳山提家客楊子術有所援引，並因德政勸顯祖行禪代之事。
units.en: Regular attendant Xu Zhicai and retainer Song Jingye were versed first in astronomy and apocrypha; also Chen Shanti's household retainer Yang Zishu had connections—all through Dezheng urged Gao Yang to carry out the abdication and succession.
units.literal: Regular attendant Xu Zhicai and retainer Song Jingye were versed first in astronomy and apocrypha; also Chen Shanti's household retainer Yang Zishu had connections—all through Dezheng urged Gao Yang to carry out the abdication and succession.

units.zh: 崔暹，字季倫，博陵安平人，漢尚書寔之後也，世為北州著姓。
units.en: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han minister of works, and for generations a leading house of the northern provinces.
units.literal: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han Minister of Works, and for generations a prominent clan of the northern provinces.

units.zh: 之才云：「今與王爭天下者，彼意亦欲為帝，譬如逐兔滿市，一人得之，衆心皆定。
units.en: Xu Zhicai said, "Whoever contends with you for the realm today wants to be emperor too — like chasing a rabbit through a crowded market: once one man catches it, every heart settles.
units.literal: Xu Zhicai said: "He who contends with you for the realm today likewise means to become emperor — like chasing a rabbit through a crowded market: once one man catches it, every heart is settled.

units.zh: 今若先受魏禪，關西自應息心。
units.en: Accept Wei's abdication first and Guanxi should quiet of itself.
units.literal: If you accept Wei's abdication first, Guanxi should of itself quiet its heart.

units.zh: 縱欲屈強，止當逐我稱帝。
units.en: Even if they mean to force the issue, at most they will chase us in declaring themselves emperor.
units.literal: Even if they wish to bend their strength against us, at most they will chase us in proclaiming emperorship.

units.zh: 必宜知機先覺，無容後以學人。」
units.en: You must know the moment and move first — no learning from others after the fact."
units.literal: You must seize the moment and be first to perceive the chance — no room to learn from others afterward."

units.zh: 顯祖入，召弼入與徐之才相告。
units.en: Gao Yang went in and summoned Bi to tell Xu Zhicai together.
units.literal: Gao Yang entered and summoned Bi in to tell Xu Zhicai together.

units.zh: 徐之才、宋景業等每言卜筮雜占陰陽緯侯，必宜五月應天順人，德政亦勸不已。
units.en: Xu Zhicai, Song Jingye, and others kept speaking of divination, mixed auguries, yin and yang, and omens in the weft-texts — that May was the time to answer Heaven and win men; Dezheng urged on without pause.
units.literal: Xu Zhicai, Song Jingye, and others constantly spoke of divination, miscellaneous auguries, yin and yang, and the weft-texts of omens — that May was surely the time to answer Heaven and accord with men; Dezheng too urged without cease.

units.zh: 德政、徐之才苦請帝曰：「山提先去，若為形容，恐其漏泄不果。」
units.en: Dezheng and Xu Zhicai pressed Gao Yang hard: "Shanti went ahead — if appearances give it away, I fear the leak will ruin everything."
units.literal: Dezheng and Xu Zhicai bitterly begged the emperor: "Shanti went ahead — if word gets out through how things look, I fear the leak will undo the affair."

units.zh: 武定八年，侯景叛，除東南道行臺尚書，封江夏縣男，與高岳等破侯景，擒蕭明。
units.en: In the eighth year of Wuding, Hou Jing rebelled. Shu was made masters of writing on the southeastern mobile grand secretariat and enfeoffed as nan (baron) of Jiangxia county. With Gao Yue and others he broke Hou Jing and took Xiao Ming prisoner.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Wuding, Hou Jing rebelled; Shu was appointed Masters of Writing on the Southeastern Circuit Mobile Grand Secretariat, enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiangxia county (male), and with Gao Yue and others defeated Hou Jing and captured Xiao Ming.

units.zh: 何定遠之足高，營平之獨美！
units.en: How could Dingyuan alone be lofty, or Yingping alone beautiful!
units.literal: How could Dingyuan alone be lofty, or Yingping alone beautiful!

units.zh: 武平四年五月，帝使徐之範飲以毒藥。
units.en: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Wuping, the emperor had Xu Zhifan make him drink poison.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Wuping, the emperor had Xu Zhifan make him drink poison.
